description: This file defines a Python module for a Mem0 memory service integration within the Pipecat framework. It includes a class Mem0MemoryService responsible for storing and retrieving conversational memories using the Mem0 library, to enhance an LLM's context. The file contains detailed configuration via a nested InputParams class, methods for message storage, memory retrieval, context enhancement, and frame processing in an asynchronous pipeline.

classes.name: Mem0MemoryService
classes.description: A standalone class implementing a memory service that interfaces with Mem0 to store and retrieve messages and memories, enhancing conversation context within the Pipecat framework.

classes.name: InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the Mem0MemoryService, including search limits, threshold, API version, system prompt, message addition method, and position.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: Optional[str] = None, local_config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, user_id: Optional[str] = None, agent_id: Optional[str] = None, run_id: Optional[str] = None, params: Optional[InputParams] = None, host: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Mem0MemoryService with provided API keys, configurations, user/agent/run identifiers, and parameters, setting up the Mem0 client.

methods.name: _store_messages(self, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Stores a list of message dictionaries into Mem0, with optional asynchronous operation.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _retrieve_memories(self, query: str)
methods.description: Queries Mem0 for memories relevant to a given query string, returning a list of memory dicts.

methods.name: _enhance_context_with_memories(self, context: LLMContext | OpenAILLMContext, query: str)
methods.description: Augments the provided LLM context with retrieved memories formatted as a system or user message.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a frame in the pipeline, intercepts context frames to retrieve and store memories, and passes frames downstream.
